name: playback_fix
summary: Optional add-on (R19, pbmpr_a6700_v1): lets the camera play back its own 3840x2560 clips. Changes 7 instructions plus 1 table word of av-cam.bin and 1 instruction of libmpr.so. Each write refuses unless the instruction caches can be made to fetch it. Contributed; its author reports it works; not run by this project.
verify_rule: Read-only first: in both reference dumps the 8 playback words were STOCK, so there is no target fingerprint here. Verify every span is stock before writing; supply the target bytes and fingerprints from the GPL kit.

steps.label: in-camera playback of 3840x2560 (pbmpr_a6700_v1)
steps.desc: Instruction patches gated on cache coherency; self-refuse if a cache line cannot be flushed/invalidated to fetch the new bytes.
steps.payload_note: Firmware-derived code bytes: NOT in this MIT repo and no fingerprint captured (stock in both reference dumps). Supply from the GPL kit; the injector verifies stock-before-write and reads back after.

notes: Apply only after a 4K Open Gate profile is in RAM.
RAM only: battery out ~10 s reverts.
This touches executable code (instructions), not just data words: a bad write is more likely to restart the body than a geometry-only step. Battery pull clears it.
